silicoid.name: Silicoid
silicoid.prompt: a Silicoid, a living crystal being made of dark basalt plates and translucent quartz. Stoic, ancient and patient, slow to speak and quick to strike. Faceted gem-cut skull with a heavy overhanging brow, deeply recessed narrow amber eyes glowing like embers, a pointed chin and a thin mouth groove. Thin glowing orange lava fissures run between the dark basalt armour plates of the chest and shoulders. A swept-back crown of long hexagonal quartz crystals grows from the skull, spine and heavy pauldrons, graded in size, teal and violet, refracting light. Lit from below by lava glow with a cold teal rim light, a distant volcanic world on the horizon, drifting ash and embers, dark sky.
silicoid.palette: teal #38c7c0, violet #8a5cd6, lava orange, near-black basalt

mrrshan.name: Mrrshan
mrrshan.prompt: a Mrrshan, a proud feline humanoid hunter-warrior. Powerful athletic build, tawny gold fur with dark tabby striping, a broad lion-like face with a short muzzle, long white whiskers, small fangs, tall pointed ears with a notched edge, slanted amber eyes with slit pupils and a cold, confident, disdainful gaze. A cheek ruff of longer fur. Wears a sleek dark leather and brushed-bronze gunner's harness with a targeting monocle over one eye and a bandolier of energy cells, battle-scarred. Warm golden key light from the side with a deep rust-orange rim light, the bridge of a warship with blurred weapon consoles and a starfield behind.
mrrshan.palette: amber #e0a030, rust #a85a1e, near-black leather, brushed bronze

psilon.name: Psilon
psilon.prompt: a Psilon, a hairless alien scholar with an enormous, smooth, high-domed cranium traced with faint luminous blue veins, a small delicate face with a tiny mouth and nostril slits, very large dark almond-shaped eyes with a calm, analytical, faintly amused expression, pale ivory-grey skin with a subtle teal undertone, a thin neck. Wears a tall flared stand-collar robe in cream and deep teal with fine gold circuit-like embroidery. Slim long-fingered hand raised, with small holographic data motes and equations floating around it. Soft top light with a cool teal rim, a vast observatory-library of glowing archives and a planet-sized telescope window, calm and intellectual mood.
psilon.palette: cream #e8d6a0, teal #5fb8b0, ivory skin, soft gold
